label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Si en su soledad viene, en su soledad saldrá; si dueño de mujer él, y saldrá su mujer con él.
spanish: Si en su cuerpo viene, en su cuerpo saldrá; si él *es* dueño de mujer, y saldrá su mujer con él.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'soledad' (solitude) with 'cuerpo' at both occurrences of H1610 (sourceTokenIds h02021003002, h02021003004); those tokens license body/back/person, not an abstract emotional noun.
Supplied the copula 'es' (italicized) for the verbless Hebrew nominal clause 'dueño de mujer él' and moved the pronoun to subject position, since Spanish requires a finite verb there.
readerNote: Chose 'cuerpo' from the licensed body/back/person sense for H1610 rather than 'soledad'; supplied copula *es* in italics for the verbless clause 'dueño de mujer'.
